newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Nexus Telecom 1996 loss per share $0.86.
newsitem.headline: Nexus Telecom 1996 loss per share $0.86.

text.p: (in thousands of dollars except per share)
Operating profit n/a n/a loss 4,848 loss 5,690
Net Profit loss 1,425 loss 1,389 loss 5,294 loss 6,168
EPS (fully diluted) n/a n/a loss 0.86 loss 0.90
Nexus attributed the losses in 1996 to research and development expenses for its two way paging and vehicle location system and an increase in related marketing efforts.

"The company has reached the stage where the research and development phase of the two way paging and location network is moving nearer to completion and the company's resources are directed towards commercialisation of the system," Nexus said in a statement.
The Israeli company is a 31 percent owned affiliate of BVR Technologies Ltd.
